title: Recursion capacity-pool manifest v1
description: Documentation/box-tooling schema for scripts/capacity-pools/<id>.json. The authoritative, self-contained validation lives in scripts/assignment.py:validate_capacity_pool (no jsonschema dependency at runtime); this schema exists to document the contract accurately and to support editor/CI tooling. A capacity pool names an account/subscription/quota identity an assignment may bind to — never a credential value. See docs/plans/recursion-v2-execution-fabric.md 'Capacity pool' and state/DECISIONS.md D-016.

id.description: Must equal the manifest filename stem (e.g. cursor-ultra.json -> "cursor-ultra").

source.description: "observed" means the reset/limit is measured from provider behavior; "declared" means it is a human-entered policy value.

limit.description: null means no declared ceiling (informational reconciliation only).

on_demand.description: Whether this pool may fall back to metered/on-demand spend once its quota is exhausted. Human-owned; never flipped by a worker.
